Working in /opt/nxeon-v2 (Next.js app, branch design/v2) — a hosting platform's customer dashboard. This is a READ-ONLY audit before production promotion — do not edit or fix anything, only report findings with file:line evidence. This feature has not been audited yet.

The Prisma `ChangelogEntry` model recently gained a `kind` field ("FEATURE | IMPROVEMENT | BUGFIX, author-set (never inferred from the title) — drives the icon/tone and the What's New page's category filter"). Audit `app/dashboard/whats-new/page.tsx` and whatever admin authoring UI exists for changelog entries (search app/admin for "changelog" or "ChangelogEntry").

Check and report:
1. **Is the changelog content real and admin-authored**, or could it contain any hardcoded/seeded placeholder entries that would ship to production looking like real product announcements? Check for any seed script or hardcoded array of changelog entries.
2. **Does the admin authoring UI actually let an admin set the `kind` field** (FEATURE/IMPROVEMENT/BUGFIX) when creating/editing an entry, or is it only settable directly in the DB (meaning every real-world entry defaults to "FEATURE" per the schema default, undermining the stated category filter)?
3. **Does the customer-facing What's New page's category filter actually work** — filtering by `kind` — and does the icon/tone (mentioned in the schema comment as driven by `kind`) actually render differently per kind, or is this cosmetic/unfinished?
4. **"Unread" tracking**: is there any real "mark as read" / "new since you last visited" mechanic (common for changelog features, e.g. a badge showing unread count), and if so is it backed by a real per-user read-marker (not just a client-side localStorage flag that would reset/lie across devices)?
5. Any broken link or reference to features that don't exist (dead internal links from a changelog entry to a feature page)?

Report as a table: Aspect | REAL / PARTIAL / STUB | evidence (file:line) | concern. Keep under 500 words. Do not modify any files.
